operations.original: [L1] A countable chart cover detects manifold nullity ([[prop-a-countable-chart-cover-detects-manifold-null-sets]]).
operations.proposed: [L1] In positive dimension, nullity means Euclidean nullity of every chart image in a smooth atlas; in dimension zero the only null subset is empty ([[def-null-subset-of-a-smooth-manifold]]).

operations.original: 1.1 Fix a countable smooth atlas detecting nullity as in [L1]. For each chart $(U_j,\varphi_j)$, the set $\varphi_j(A\cap U_j)$ is contained in the null set $\varphi_j(E\cap U_j)$, so [F1] makes it null. Thus $A$ is null. [F1, L1, given]
operations.proposed: 1.1 If $\dim M=0$, [L1] gives $E=E_m=\varnothing$ for every $m$, hence $A=\varnothing$ and $\bigcup_{m\ge1}E_m=\varnothing$; both are null. Henceforth assume $\dim M\ge1$ and fix any smooth atlas on $M$. For each of its charts $(U_j,\varphi_j)$, the set $\varphi_j(A\cap U_j)$ is contained in the null set $\varphi_j(E\cap U_j)$, so [F1] makes it null. Thus $A$ is null by [L1]. [F1, L1, given, cases]
